en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, fromJameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Abdul Muttalib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> would be Resurrected on the Day of Judgment as one community. Upon him<sup>saww</sup> would be a mark of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> and ‘هَيْبَةُ’ awe of the kings’.
